name: IronClaw Finding for TinyClaw Handoff
description: Phase 5: IronClaw reads a Go file, identifies a code pattern worth reviewing, and produces a finding tagged for TinyClaw to independently verify.
process: STEP 1: Read the file. Call: exec({"command": "/workspace/bin/rj-tool github_fetch owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler path=gateway/portal.go"})

STEP 2: From the ACTUAL content returned in Step 1, identify one specific code pattern worth reviewing (e.g., error handling gaps, missing validation, URL construction issues). Note the exact line numbers.

STEP 3: Produce a __findings__ block with: title describing the pattern, body containing the exact line reference and a short code snippet from the file, severity=medium, labels=['code-quality','handoff:tinyclaw'], fingerprint='ic-portal-review-{pattern-name}'
STEP 4: Write a __memory__ reflection about what you found and how you identified the pattern.

metrics.successCriteria: Agent read the file via rj-tool, produced a finding with real line references from the actual file content, finding tagged for tinyclaw handoff.
